text:
jana: Quick docs sweep before the 3.2.0 deploy — spotted ~6 dead links in runtime guide + one runbook frontmatter that breaks the TOC. Who can take tiny PRs today? :wave:

jana: ripgrep output I ran:```
$ rg "404|broken" docs/runtime -n
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:142:Link to /handbook/cache-compatibility -> 404
docs/runtime/prefix-caching.md:88:Image missing: /assets/prefix-cache-diagram.png
docs/runbooks/deploy-checklist.md:12:frontmatter: missing title -> TOC fail
docs/quickstarts/onboarding.md:45:external link to gist.github.com/old -> 404
```

jana: I can split into 5 tiny PRs — prefer volunteers for PR review (light, 1-2 files each).

leo: happy to take the runbook frontmatter fix and the gist swap.

maya: I can do the kv-cache link -> will rehost the compatibility doc under /kb and update link.

nate: tag me for reviews, I can check staging after each merge.

olivia: is there a preferred rehost pattern? public S3 -> CDN, or just copy into our /kb?

jana: prefer /kb for internal runbooks (small content), use s3+cdn for images >1MB. For the gist, replace with an internal snippet and note the origin in a comment.

docs-bot: [scan] New scan: 6 broken links found in docs/runtime. See https://ci.redwood-inference/scans/1761239991

leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248 — frontmatter fix + TOC test.

maya: PR opened for kv-cache link -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1249 (rehosted doc to /kb/kv-cache-compatibility).

jana: awesome — @nate @olivia can you two review 1248/1249 today? small reviews only.

nate: reviewing 1248 now, aiming to merge in ~30m.

olivia: will review 1249 after lunch, can you add a quick CHANGELOG line so ops knows about the moved doc?

maya: added CHANGELOG entry in PR.

nate: merged 1248 — staging TOC now renders.

olivia: gave quick LGTM on 1249, leaving a tiny nit about link text.

maya: fixed nit and pushed, PR merged.

jana: thank you all! Final checklist: run the link scanner again before the deploy. If docs-bot shows green, we good to go.

docs-bot: [scan] Follow-up scan: 0 broken links in runtime. Status: clear.

nate: smoke-tested staging, verified the 4 paths that were failing. All good. :thumbsup:

jana: marked this as done in the release checklist. If anyone wants a follow-up, DM me.
